title: Local game activity
description: Specified, not executed. Additive local activity/adapter contract. Fixed game protocol only; no Lua evaluation, arbitrary paths/URLs, OS commands, hidden-state disclosure, camera audience or PWCE world evidence.

ActivityScope.description: Host-owned scope. Game timelines never authenticate people, establish camera audience, grant world authority or become PWCE facts.

ActivityContextBinding.description: Trusted runtime logical activity participation, not a fabricated user turn or physical endpoint/audience assertion. Owner/relationship permission is checked separately; no owner-private speaker or audio clearance is inherited.

schedule.description: Autonomous configured-hours starts are the selected V1 rule, separate from actual operator enrollment/enablement. Initial setup is disabled with no invented timezone/windows. Enabled scheduling requires a valid IANA timezone, nonoverlapping local-day half-open windows (split overnight windows), current validated policy revision, explicit finite GameBounds, authority and prerequisites. Host occurrence identity/deduplication survives restart and DST repeats; a paused/interrupted run requires resume, never a replacement automatic start.

contactConfiguration.description: Selected help contact uses existing initiative/disclosure/recipient authority only through an explicitly configured channel, recipient and contact-hours timezone/windows. Actual setup defaults disabled/null. Missing channel, unavailable delivery, disallowed time or current privacy defers one bounded deduplicated help item; queued/sent/delivered/replied requires corresponding evidence, and a reply is advice only after authenticated attribution.

GamePolicy.description: All V1 behavior choices are selected: configured-hours autonomous starts; ordinary in-game save/load only; configured-channel/help-hours contact. Actual enrollment, hours, limits, channel and recipient remain disabled/unconfigured until supplied. Emulator savestates, snapshots, rewind and crash-recovery exceptions are forbidden. Existing live authority and privacy checks remain mandatory.

GameBounds.description: Required finite configured budgets. Graphical game rendering runs at ordinary 1x speed independently of model planning: no hidden fast-forward, rewind or model-paced frame stepping. Commands remain at most120 frames/2000ms; expiry releases held input while ordinary game progression continues, except explicit interruption or safety pause. No default play hours, capacity or budgets are invented. Planning age and frame-delta ceilings are mandatory finite setup values, independent of physical-camera freshness; no numeric default is adopted.

qualificationRef.description: Optional prior evidence reference, not authority, admission or a prerequisite for a separately authorized qualification run. Readiness never claims accepted game/provider quality.

GameArtifactPins.description: Reference adapter pins only. Fixture digests are synthetic. Actual user-supplied game/emulator/core/script/visible-state manifest identities must be verified before readiness. Movie/TAStudio, unsupported core/platform/API combinations and external input contention are unavailable.

GameScreenshot.description: Purpose-scoped ephemeral screenshot bytes resolved only inside the selected perception adapter. No raw/base64/URL/path in control JSON. Not a camera frame, audience input, durable game save or normal conversational prompt attachment.

PlayerVisibleFact.description: Visible facts have screen provenance. An approved manifest-bound visible-UI extractor cannot expose hidden RAM, undiscovered maps, offscreen enemies, plot flags, guides, walkthroughs or solutions. User advice is separately attributed input, never a game observation.

PlayerVisibleStateValue.description: Value must match its reviewed manifest field schema and evidenced visibility on this exact game/core/timeline. Previously revealed values remain dated knowledge, not falsely current exact state. No arbitrary memory address or neighboring field is exported.

GameObservation.description: One current visible observation at a decision boundary. Lifecycle/chronology stay separate from model interpretation. No visible-person count, camera privacy claim, hidden state or real-world truth is admitted.

GameActionProposal.description: Inert bounded proposal from the cited planning observation/prepared view. During model latency the live 1x game continues; the host must obtain a new dispatch observation and deterministically check all relevant allowlisted scene/UI predicates before fresh capability admission. Changed/uncertain predicates reject/replan. Empty buttons means neutral input during ordinary live frames, not model-paced frame advance.

GameAdmission.description: Trusted runtime injection only, never a model/browser credential. Adapter resolves the immutable canonical dispatch receipt and exact input/scope/policy binding against the local authenticated admission ledger before the effect. Shape-valid data is not authority.

GameActionReceipt.description: Durable at-most-once attempt/outcome ledger. Unknown is not a success or a safe retry. Release is separately confirmed; a disconnect/watchdog failure pauses the activity and requires reconciliation, never blind redispatch.

GameSaveArtifact.description: Opaque ordinary in-game SaveRAM bytes only, using configured sandboxed copies without overwriting the operator initial save. Verify actual file/digest/game/core identity and ordinary in-game load/readback behavior. No emulator savestate/snapshot, rewind state, hidden-state decoding or crash-recovery exception is permitted.

ActivityCheckpoint.description: Durable host metadata (goals, outcomes, budgets, advice, policies, idempotency and optional ordinary SaveRAM reference) is not an emulator snapshot. Crash resume uses actual ordinary in-game load, accepts lost unsaved progress, observes/reconciles the new current state and never reconstructs/replays actions. Host memory tombstones, consumed authority and budgets never roll back. campaignJournalRef binds independently persisted compact campaign continuity across runs; write meaningful goal/story changes incrementally and before normal termination, under the same finite checkpoint storage budget and correction/forgetting fences.

presentation.description: Both Linux and Windows require a running actual graphical BizHawk window on an accessible local or configured remote display, including away play. A human viewer need not be connected. GUI/display loss pauses or makes the activity unavailable; a headless core, screenshot replay or preview alone is not watchable game execution.

GameActivityState.description: State is truthful configuration/lifecycle, not inferred from installed emulator or a screenshot. Running requires actual qualified pins, current policy/admission, exclusive input and shared scheduler capacity. Live waiting-for-observation/planning states retain the same pins, finite bounds, connected adapter, graphical watchability and exclusive finite input lease as running.

payload.description: Internal purpose-bound host-side observe-adapter DTO, not a fifth public port or Lua model call. Only this adapter step may resolve authorized transient game image bytes for a configured image-capable backend. Normal nine-section inference receives typed text only; camera leases/audience are forbidden. Egress, current scope, byte/digest/frame limits and shared optional-work admission remain mandatory.

dispatchValidation.description: Trusted deterministic revalidation against the fresh live dispatch observation, never model self-certification. Exact current frame/epoch/timeline/input ownership is bound atomically at dispatch; the earlier planning frame may differ if every typed current precondition still holds. Source capture time/frame and prepared-context expiry must match stored host records; the host enforces configured maxPlanningAgeMs/maxPlanningFrameDelta and finite context freshness at dispatch. Values in this DTO cannot renew or self-certify their sources.

payload.description: Trusted ownership withdrawal. Under exclusive ownership send explicit false for every allowlisted button; joypad.set({}) merely removes overrides and is not proof of neutral input. Pause and neutralize before detaching; target an exact lease so stale release never affects a successor.

anyOf.description: Exact old-lease safety withdrawal uses trusted host shutdown intent, even after gameplay authority revocation. Confirm neutral controls AND actual BizHawk pause with equal two post-pause frame samples at increasing monotonic times, after cancelling/fencing the old epoch; lost/negative acknowledgement remains unknown/failure. Never act on a successor lease. Resume requires fresh observation/current authority and keeps budgets; queued actions are not replayed.

payload.description: Exact old-lease safety withdrawal uses trusted host shutdown intent, even after gameplay authority revocation. Confirm neutral controls AND actual BizHawk pause with equal two post-pause frame samples at increasing monotonic times, after cancelling/fencing the old epoch; lost/negative acknowledgement remains unknown/failure. Never act on a successor lease. Resume requires fresh observation/current authority and keeps budgets; queued actions are not replayed.

Only flush or verify bytes produced by ordinary game saves. Loading occurs through admitted normal game-menu controller actions. Never create/load an emulator savestate, rewind or reconstruct unsaved progress, including after a crash. The semantic flushSaveRam operation must map to an actually qualified persistence mechanism for the pinned BizHawk build; it does not assert any Lua function named flushsaveram or rely on automatic SaveRAM flushing. Verification requires actual persisted bytes/digest plus normal game restart/load qualification.

GameDecisionInput.description: Bounded sidecar materialized with the one normal prepared context, not a separate prompt builder or extra inference section. Game facts/advice occupy existing untrusted conversation and preparedMemory prompt sections within the unchanged nine-section inference input; only host capability/counter state is trusted. No human statement, physical audience or audio owner is fabricated. The exact journal summary and bounded relevant unfinished goals are selected atomically into the same existing conversation/preparedMemory sections before action; there is no extra journal prompt section. Current story/milestone selections require game-specific current-timeline reconciliation.

GameExperienceEpisode.description: Selective existing-memory input with explicit simulated-game provenance and timeline. No owner statement, camera event, real-world fact or automatic skill/persona change. Reload/replay cannot multiply independent evidence; abandoned timelines remain qualified history, not current game truth.

GameMemoryBinding.description: Required lifestream.localGameActivity MemoryRecord extension. Validate exact episode/revision/activity/run/timeline/artifact binding and source lifecycle at write, recall/export/import. Transformation confidence is attributed, never fabricated perception certainty.

GameMemoryProjection.description: Direct simulated-game episode projection only. Actual human advice has separately attributed participantStatement provenance; game observations never become human statements, physical worldGrounded facts or authority.

GameHelpScreenshot.description: Relevant actual game framebuffer capture attached to this question, never camera/unrelated desktop/debugger content. Binds the exact source observation/run/timeline/frame/time and verified existing attachment bytes/digest. Queued sending requires still-authorized bounded local attachment retention and an unexpired artifact; computed age/capture moment must be disclosed honestly. No new upload/hosting service or broader screenshot retention is granted. Resolve the source screenshotId inside the recorded GameObservation and compare frame, capture time, digest, byte length, media type and dimensions before using the attachment; a known observation ID alone is insufficient.

GameHelpItem.description: Internal mapping onto existing initiative/message attachment machinery, not a new contact service or port. Actual attempts and one specific question accompany the relevant game screenshot. Channel/recipient/hours/privacy and attachment authority remain independent. Unsupported images, expiry or attachment failure defers/reports a limitation; no bare text is reported as screenshot delivery. Use only an already authorized image-capable route. Each sent/delivered/replied state requires its corresponding actual evidence; authenticated advice must enter a fresh plan. status tracks the message independently of attachmentStatus; uploaded/transferred evidence never proves image sent/delivered. Explicitly permitted text-only fallback may be sent/replied with a failed, unsupported or unknown attachment, but must disclose the missing screenshot and a limitation. Its permission comes from the existing delivery policy, never from this record. Attachment delivery requires separate actual receipt evidence.

items.description: Compact sourced campaign knowledge. Observation means reported source evidence, not guaranteed truth. Inference, authenticated attributed advice and pretrained/prior knowledge remain distinct; no prior knowledge is relabeled as a discovery.
Stable goal identity and explicit lifecycle survive sessions. An completed historical goal does not prove it remains completed after loading an older save.

CampaignJournal.description: Small activity-neutral durable journal core: sourced discoveries, story, unresolved threads, goals, advice and session summaries. It requires no emulator, game, save, platform or adapter. Existing checkpoint storage, privacy, correction/forgetting and context quotas govern it; this is not a new memory engine, agent, prompt history or general activity framework. Persist meaningful progress incrementally and before normal end; metadata durability never implies emulator-state capture.

CampaignJournalRef.description: Exact host-stored journal revision/access binding selected atomically into existing prepared context and checkpoint. It is invalidated by source correction, privacy change or forgetting; a stale record cannot resurrect removed material.

items.description: Game source binding; only qualified current entries may describe the current save/timeline. Historical learning can remain after older-save load without claiming lost milestones.

GameCampaignJournal.description: Concrete Chrono Trigger game binding around the activity-neutral journal. Campaign identity spans run/session changes but remains pinned to the selected game profile and ordinary-save lineage. New observed campaigns before the first ordinary save may have null save/lineage; restart without an ordinary save cannot reconstruct unsaved emulator state. Resume requires loaded journal summary/bounded unfinished goals, exact revision/access joins, fresh visible-state and actual ordinary-save reconciliation before action. Missing/stale/contradictory sources pause for reconciliation/help. Historical entries from progress lost by older-save loading remain dated history, never current milestone claims. Opaque saves are never decoded into cognition; all emulator snapshots remain forbidden.
